name: FPV / LINE

prompts.wordmark: Use case: logo-brand. Create a finished, distinctive game logo for the exact title "FPV / LINE". Asset: a single tightly framed horizontal transparent wordmark, about 3:1 aspect ratio, suitable for a pixel-art game's dark landing menu, website header and title screen. Brand idea: a small FPV drone flying a precise stepped line that claims territory. On the left, create an original compact geometric top-down quadcopter/flight-path emblem: four squared rotor corners surrounding a diamond-like central flight-direction slash, with a short stepped cyan trail. Integrate it visually with the wordmark, not a separate badge. Text MUST read exactly FPV / LINE, in that order, on ONE baseline. Custom heavy readable angular pixel lettering, crafted on a disciplined coarse pixel grid with crisp square steps, generous counters and clean spacing. FPV in warm ivory (#edf6f3); forward slash and leading flight-path details electric cyan (#7adff1); LINE in warm signal yellow (#ffda6b). A very subtle dark navy edge permits use over art. The wordmark is the hero; emblem height approximately cap height, not giant. Flat screenprinted pixel geometry, confident and refined arcade / field-equipment aesthetic, no military insignia, no flags, no weapons, no wings, no shield, no gradients, no photorealistic drone, no tiny slogans, no 3D bevels, no glow bloom, no background panel, no drop shadow, no watermark, no extra text, no concept-sheet variations. Actual transparent background with preserved alpha. Crop composition close to logo with only a modest safety margin.
